# Third-party fixture

These files are copied unmodified from [srobroek/speckit-roadmap](https://github.com/srobroek/speckit-roadmap), tag `v0.1.0` (archive `refs/tags/v0.1.0.zip`), under the Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE`.

Copied files:

- `.specify/memory/roadmap.md`
- `specs/001-roadmap-write/`, `specs/002-roadmap-brief/`, `specs/003-roadmap-debrief/`, `specs/004-roadmap-sync/`: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`

They are a test fixture: a real roadmap written by the speckit-roadmap extension. Exercising it is not a certification of upstream compatibility.
